name: LaTeX Submission Lint: Desk-Reject Check
subtitle: Seventeen rules on your .tex file: the statements the editorial office looks for, and the source that breaks the publisher's build.
free: Checks the .tex file you have open against all 17 submission rules and writes a line-numbered report of every statement the publisher will look for and cannot find.
paid: Runs the same 17 rules over every .tex file in the project, follows the include chain of a split manuscript, and exports one submission-readiness report for the whole paper.
need_key: This option needs a licence (LaTeX Submission Lint: Desk-Reject Check).
